text:
Ellen: flagging an urgent scope question for Friday exec packet. Third-party model provider bumped their inference contract; potential 2-week delay. Need decisions: pull feature X from MVP or accept timeline shift.
Mateo: what's impact on public launch vs internal v1?
Ellen: public launch would lose k-NN reranking and advanced embeddings tuning. v1 can include both.
Rashid: engineering estimate: integrating fallback models and compatibility shim = ~1.5 engineer-weeks; full switch to alternate provider = 4+ weeks.
Kira: product trade: keep core generation and chat flows; cut reranker and advanced embeddings for MVP. Communicate as "coming in v1" in release notes.
Mateo: sales: two pilots require improved embeddings for ranking. Can we offer a temporary SLA exception or private patch?
Ellen: options on table: A) shift launch 2 weeks to keep features, B) cut reranker/advanced embeddings to v1, C) ship with a degraded experience + commit timeline to pilots.
Rashid: Ops note: degraded experience requires fallback model routing and smoothing; adds runtime risk but feasible in 10 days.
Kira: UX note: if we cut reranker, plan microcopy and fallback CTAs so pilots aren't surprised.
Mateo: propose decision: choose B for MVP, but commit a pilot patch timeline (4 weeks) for the two pilot accounts and offer credits.
Ellen: agree, leaning B. Need owners and acceptance criteria.
Rashid: Owner for fallback routing (if needed): Eng infra (Rashid) — acceptance: p95 latency < 300ms for 1h on canary, and automatic traffic steering test pass.
Kira: Owner for comms: Product (Kira) — acceptance: release notes + pilot emails drafted and approved by legal.
Mateo: Sales owner: tag pilot accounts and confirm compensation package. Acceptance: pilot sign-off or written acknowledgement within 48h.
release-bot: Release checklist updated: public-launch-mvp: replaced reranker with "v1" label, docs changed (PR #4256).
Ellen: I'll record decision B in the milestone doc and push to exec packet. Please drop one-line owners into the ticket.
Mateo: done. Added pilot notes.
Kira: I'll draft microcopy and CTAs by tomorrow morning.
Ellen: thanks everyone. If any blocker, reply here.
